description:
Avarwand Batch File Zipper

ABFZ is a powerful, offline, modern GUI tool for batch compression of files and folders into ZIP or RAR archives, with optional individual password protection (AES-256) for each archive.
- New: "Check for Updates" button in the Info window.
- New: optional automatic update check at startup (off by default, at most once every 24 hours).
- New: update window with Download, Later and Skip this version.
- The Info window now shows the installed version.
- Nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
